articles.title: Letter: Support the Senior Exercise Class
body: To the editor: Please keep the senior exercise class in the budget. Many of us on Glen Street use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting.
Nora Lindqvist, Upper Commons
